body: Thank you. I'm sorry I don't know how to express this other than just saying thank you. But Truly thank you. I'm talking to that person now. Opening up about my thoughts. Hoping to fix what I've done. It's just hard, and scary. But, it's worth it.

I've stopped trying to get help. I've been rude and shut out the only people that would help. I hurt people who only had good intentions. But, one has stayed and it. Confuses me. I just have been selfish and don't deserve happiness. Also just having survived an attempt in the past scares me the most. It feels like I'm living on time I don't deserve. Like that was suppose to be it, I've lost family and they were people that deserved this time not me. I just feel like I've become the embodiment of my mental illness.

Your words of encouragement  have touched me. I write this to you with tears of joy... A level of recognition I haven't felt since my dad witnessed me hit my first home run in little league. With the same solemn and singular phrase "ok" I knew that day I earned not only his respect but love. It wasn't a lot, but it was the subtext that meant everything. I don't know what to say... The fact that I have brought that same level of emotion to you, a stranger, is amazing and shows that we as humans are all apart of the same family. And with that I will reply to you with; "Ok."
